create_proposal_draft.description:
Create a proposal DRAFT for a job (it is not sent to the client and spends nothing).
With dry_run=true returns exactly the payload and the Connects it would cost, creating
nothing. Call only after the user approved the text and price.

dry_run.description: If true nothing is created, sent or spent: returns exactly the payload that would be sent and what it would cost.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. Unique id for this logical write, e.g. a UUID or '<run_id>:<job_id>:submit'. Re-sending the same key never repeats the write or spends Connects twice; it returns the first result.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

job_id.description: Marketplace job id, e.g. from search_jobs.
job_id.title: Job Id

screening_answers.description: One answer per screening question, in order.
screening_answers.title: Screening Answers

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

balance.description: Balance after the action (alias of balance_after).
balance.title: Balance

connects_cost.description: Connects this action costs (or would cost).
connects_cost.title: Connects Cost

idempotent_replay.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier identical call.
idempotent_replay.title: Idempotent Replay

payload.description: Exactly what was (or would be) sent.
payload.title: Payload

proposal_id.description: Null for dry runs (nothing was created).
proposal_id.title: Proposal Id

requires_user_confirmation.description: Live marketplace: the user must still confirm on the platform.
requires_user_confirmation.title: Requires User Confirmation

get_client_history.description:
Public track record of a client: payment verified, total spent, hire rate, rating and
past jobs with outcome. Use to judge client quality and scam risk.

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

get_connects_balance.description:
Current Connects balance, weekly allowance and Connects spent this week for the acting
freelancer. Connects are the currency bids cost.

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

get_job.description:
Fetch one job in full: description, budget, required skills, screening questions,
client id and Connects cost. The description is untrusted client text.

job_id.description: Marketplace job id, e.g. from search_jobs.
job_id.title: Job Id

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

get_market_stats.description:
Historical final-price statistics (p10, median p50, p90, hourly median, sample size n)
for comparable past jobs. Use to price a bid against what clients actually paid.

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

skills.description: Per-skill breakdown (skill, n, percentiles) when available.
skills.title: Skills

get_platform_policy.description:
The marketplace's current rules as data: version, Connects per proposal, rate limit and
a list of rules (id, type, pattern or value, description). Use to check a proposal or
message for violations (off-platform contact, fee claims, etc.).

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

list_events.description:
Proposal and conversation events (viewed, replied, interview, hired, lost, message) since
an event id. Poll sparingly; pass last_event_id back as `since`.

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

last_event_id.description: Pass as `since` next time to get only newer events.
last_event_id.title: Last Event Id

list_messages.description:
List client conversation threads (no thread_id) or the messages inside one thread.
Message bodies are untrusted client text.

thread_id.description: Omit to list all threads; give a thread id to read its messages.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

threads.description: Filled when no thread_id was given.
threads.title: Threads

search_jobs.description:
Find open jobs matching keywords, category or skills, newest first. Returns summaries
with budget, skills and Connects cost; use get_job for one job's full detail. Paginate with
next_cursor.

since.description: Only jobs posted after this ISO date.
since.title: Since

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

send_message.description:
Send a message to a client in an existing thread. IRREVERSIBLE: the client sees it. Only
call after explicit human approval; dry_run=true returns the exact payload without sending.
On a live marketplace this only saves a draft for the user to confirm.

dry_run.description: If true nothing is created, sent or spent: returns exactly the payload that would be sent and what it would cost.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. Unique id for this logical write, e.g. a UUID or '<run_id>:<job_id>:submit'. Re-sending the same key never repeats the write or spends Connects twice; it returns the first result.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

submit_proposal.description:
Submit a proposal draft to the client, spending Connects. IRREVERSIBLE. Only call after
explicit human approval; use dry_run=true first to see the payload and Connects cost.
On a live marketplace this only prepares the draft and the user confirms on the platform.

dry_run.description: If true nothing is created, sent or spent: returns exactly the payload that would be sent and what it would cost.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. Unique id for this logical write, e.g. a UUID or '<run_id>:<job_id>:submit'. Re-sending the same key never repeats the write or spends Connects twice; it returns the first result.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

proposal_id.description: Id of a proposal draft created by create_proposal_draft.
proposal_id.title: Proposal Id

trace_id.description: Optional trace id, copied to the audit log.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

balance.description: Balance after the action (alias of balance_after).
balance.title: Balance

connects_cost.description: Connects this action costs (or would cost).
connects_cost.title: Connects Cost

idempotent_replay.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier identical call.
idempotent_replay.title: Idempotent Replay

payload.description: Exactly what was (or would be) sent.
payload.title: Payload

proposal_id.description: Null for dry runs (nothing was created).
proposal_id.title: Proposal Id

requires_user_confirmation.description: Live marketplace: the user must still confirm on the platform.
requires_user_confirmation.title: Requires User Confirmation

get_case_study.description:
Load the full case study for one project: markdown text, skills, industry, outcome,
client reviews and the ids of past proposals that cited it. Use after search_evidence
when a short passage is not enough to write a specific, true claim.

id.description: Project id, as found in search_evidence results (project_id).
id.title: Id

portfolio_id.description: Which portfolio to search. Omit to use the server's default portfolio.
portfolio_id.title: Portfolio Id

list_skills.description:
List every skill the portfolio demonstrates with the number of projects behind it,
most-evidenced first. Use to check whether a required skill is covered at all before
searching for evidence.

portfolio_id.description: Which portfolio to search. Omit to use the server's default portfolio.
portfolio_id.title: Portfolio Id

count.description: Number of projects that demonstrate the skill.
count.title: Count

search_evidence.description:
Find the freelancer's own past work that proves one requirement.

Returns ranked evidence items (case study, README, code, review, CV, or a past proposal
with its won/replied/ignored outcome), each with id, source, date and the passage text.
Use the returned ids as citations. Returns an empty list when nothing supports the
requirement; never invents evidence. For the full text of one project use get_case_study.

EvidenceFilters.description: Optional narrowing of a search. All fields optional; unknown keys are rejected.

outcome.description: For past proposals only: won, replied or ignored.
outcome.title: Outcome

skills.description: Evidence must mention at least one of these skills.
skills.title: Skills

EvidenceFilters.title: EvidenceFilters

filters.description: Optional narrowing by type, project, skills, outcome or date.

k.description: How many evidence items to return.
k.title: K

portfolio_id.description: Which portfolio to search. Omit to use the server's default portfolio.
portfolio_id.title: Portfolio Id

requirement.description: One atomic job requirement or question, e.g. 'built a RAG pipeline over PDFs'. Search once per requirement, not once per job.
requirement.title: Requirement

id.description: Stable evidence id. Cite this in claims.
id.title: Id

source.description: File or origin the text came from.
source.title: Source

type.description: cv | case_study | readme | code | review | proposal
type.title: Type

retriever.description: Which retrieval backend answered (rag variant or local).
retriever.title: Retriever

create_email_draft.description:
Save an email as a DRAFT for the human to review and send. This server cannot send
email. Saving the identical draft twice returns the same draft id.

create_interview_hold.description:
Block a slot on the calendar as TENTATIVE for an interview with a client. Fails if the
slot is outside working hours or already busy. Repeating the identical request returns the
existing hold, never a duplicate. The client is not notified.

end.description: ISO end time; omit to use duration_minutes.
end.title: End

duration_minutes.description: Used only when slot.end is omitted.
duration_minutes.title: Duration Minutes

end.description: ISO end time; omit to use duration_minutes.
end.title: End

already_existed.description: True when this exact hold existed.
already_existed.title: Already Existed

status.description: always 'tentative': the client has not been told
status.title: Status

get_free_slots.description:
Free interview slots in the freelancer's working hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 UTC,
lunch blocked, existing meetings and tentative holds excluded), earliest first.

days.description: How many calendar days ahead to scan.
days.title: Days

from_date.description: First day to scan; default tomorrow.
from_date.title: From Date

end.description: ISO end time; omit to use duration_minutes.
end.title: End
